market_summary_3_lines: Meme perps by 4h regime: trending 16, ranging 4; median 7d move -11.9%.
Top opportunity scores: FARTCOIN (short, trending), PENGU (short, trending), PEPE (short, trending).

setup_ideas.name: Tight-range breakout long on rising volume
setup_ideas.reason: A tight 24h range broken on 1.5x volume often starts a leg as trapped shorts cover.

setup_ideas.name: Tight-range breakdown short on rising volume
setup_ideas.reason: Losing a tight range on heavy volume forces late longs out, extending the drop.

setup_ideas.name: 72h range breakout long on 2x volume
setup_ideas.reason: A multi-day base broken on double volume shows new buyers overpowering sellers.

setup_ideas.name: 55-bar-equivalent (220h) channel breakout long in uptrend
setup_ideas.reason: Classic trend following: new multi-week highs in an uptrend tend to persist in memes.

setup_ideas.name: 220h channel breakdown short in downtrend
setup_ideas.reason: Meme downtrends grind as holders capitulate; new multi-week lows tend to continue.

setup_ideas.name: Uptrend pullback to EMA50 long
setup_ideas.reason: In a stacked uptrend, dips to the 50 EMA are where trend buyers reload.

setup_ideas.name: Downtrend rally to EMA50 short
setup_ideas.reason: In a stacked downtrend, bounces into the 50 EMA are where trapped longs sell.

setup_ideas.name: Uptrend pullback to EMA20 long (shallow dip)
setup_ideas.reason: Strong meme trends rarely reach the 50 EMA; the 20 EMA is the first reload zone.

setup_ideas.name: Long after a liquidation-like down flush
setup_ideas.reason: Forced long liquidations overshoot fair value; the wick shows buyers absorbing it.

setup_ideas.name: Short after a short-squeeze spike up
setup_ideas.reason: Short squeezes overshoot; a long upper wick on huge volume shows sellers returning.

setup_ideas.name: Short when funding is extreme positive after a run-up
setup_ideas.reason: Very high funding means crowded leveraged longs paying to stay in; they unwind fast.

setup_ideas.name: Long when funding is extreme negative after a dump
setup_ideas.reason: Deeply negative funding means crowded shorts; a green bar can start a squeeze.

setup_ideas.name: Short a rally that comes with falling open interest
setup_ideas.reason: Price up while OI falls is short covering, not new buying, so the rally lacks fuel.

setup_ideas.name: Long after a dump that flushed open interest
setup_ideas.reason: Price down with OI collapsing means longs got liquidated; selling pressure is spent.

setup_ideas.name: Breakout long confirmed by rising open interest
setup_ideas.reason: A breakout with fresh OI shows new positions entering, not just shorts covering.

setup_ideas.name: Follow a strong Asia-open (00 UTC) bar
setup_ideas.reason: Asia open brings a wave of fresh flow; a strong first bar on volume often follows through.

setup_ideas.name: Follow a strong London-open (08 UTC) bar
setup_ideas.reason: London open adds European flow; a decisive first bar tends to set the day's direction.

setup_ideas.name: Follow a strong US-open (13-14 UTC) bar
setup_ideas.reason: US equity open is the heaviest flow window; a strong first bar often continues.

setup_ideas.name: Long memes lagging a BTC rally
setup_ideas.reason: When BTC rallies in a bull regime, risk appetite spills into memes with a delay.

setup_ideas.name: Short memes that haven't dropped yet as BTC falls
setup_ideas.reason: When BTC falls in a bear regime, memes usually follow down harder with a delay.

setup_ideas.name: Oversold bounce long in a flat market
setup_ideas.reason: Without a trend (low ADX), oversold readings tend to snap back to the mean.

setup_ideas.name: Overbought fade short in a flat market
setup_ideas.reason: Without a trend, overbought pops in memes get sold back into the range.

setup_ideas.name: Bollinger squeeze breakout long
setup_ideas.reason: Volatility compresses before expansion; the first close outside the band picks a side.

setup_ideas.name: Bollinger squeeze breakdown short
setup_ideas.reason: Same volatility-expansion logic, taking the downside break.

setup_ideas.name: EMA 20/50 golden cross long, only when BTC is above its 200 EMA
setup_ideas.reason: Trend changes in memes work best when the whole market is risk-on.

setup_ideas.name: EMA 20/50 death cross short, only when BTC is below its 200 EMA
setup_ideas.reason: Meme downtrends accelerate when BTC is also in a bear regime.

setup_ideas.name: Fade a +30%/24h pump on the first red bar
setup_ideas.reason: Meme pumps are driven by late FOMO buyers who become forced sellers once momentum stalls.

setup_ideas.name: Buy the first green bar after a -25%/24h dump
setup_ideas.reason: Panic dumps overshoot as stops cascade; the first green bar shows sellers exhausted.

setup_ideas.name: Uptrend volatility-contraction breakout long
setup_ideas.reason: A quiet pause inside an uptrend that breaks higher is the trend resuming.

setup_ideas.name: Downtrend volatility-contraction breakdown short
setup_ideas.reason: A quiet pause inside a downtrend that breaks lower is the trend resuming.

setup_ideas.name: 48h-low breakdown short only while BTC is below its 200 EMA
setup_ideas.reason: In a BTC bear regime, buyers of memes disappear and fresh lows tend to keep going.
